item.title: Volcanic activity formed Giant’s Causeway, scientists find
item.description:
Scientists have determined that intense volcanic activity formed the Giant’s Causeway's basalt columns about 60 million years ago. This discovery refutes local legends and provides new insights into the geological timeline of Northern Ireland's coastline.
